opening.argument: The offer presents a purported free Domino's voucher generator while making disclosure of the promised working code conditional on an external human-verification process. The description says, "After you complete the whole human-verification process you will be redirected back to the main generator page where you can find working Free Dominos Voucher fully revealed!" It further directs users to complete a survey involving personal details, including "input your name and surname, age and most probably e-mail." The generator screen displays a partially masked purported code and instructs the user to complete an offer before continuing, tying the promised free food to completion of the solicited offer.
